dogecoin.text: I told my hubby BABE, #dogecoin is 0.55 😃 Him: it will go down & never reach 0.55 again you better sell it now. Me the next day 🤯 BABE #dogecoin is 0.63 😂🚀 Him: speechless 😶.
My husband keeps telling me that #dogecoin will never reach $1 dollar.. 😂🚀 I just laughed. Just wait for it baby then cry!
